## Context / Problem
The accepted clarity analysis on ticket e759-c562-e233-4108 identified two structurally unambiguous plan defects that the current length-and-heading heuristic does not reject: empty parsed Acceptance Criteria items and unresolved sentinel assignments in active execution sections. Standalone clarity and deterministic P1 must enforce the same floor without changing ticket-type exemptions or the legacy compatibility score.

## Approach
- Add one pure shared plan-structure helper. Inside the exact `## Acceptance Criteria` section, recognize standard `- [ ]` and `- [x]` checklist items, join every continuation line until the next checklist item or H2 heading, and mark an item defective only when the joined body is whitespace-empty.
- In exact active `## Approach`, `## Scope`, `## Testing`, and `## Acceptance Criteria` sections, scan case-insensitively for the sentinel tokens `TBD`, `TODO`, `FIXME`, and `???`. Ignore fenced code and inline backtick code. A sentinel fires only when it starts a line or bullet, follows `:` or `=`, or follows the word `is`, `remains`, or `left`.
- Suppress a sentinel match when its same line contains a removal or negation term from this exact case-insensitive list: `no`, `zero`, `remove`, `delete`, `reject`, `forbid`, `must not`, `without`. Thus `Backend: TBD`, `TODO — decide cache`, and `status remains ???` fail; `NO stale TODO`, `Remove TODO markers`, and ``mention `TODO` as an example`` pass.
- Wire the shared result into standalone `clarity_check_compute` and plan-review `p1_readiness_shape`, preserving the existing clarity score as compatibility coverage.
- Add focused behavior tests before implementation, including historical negative controls and agreement between the two gate surfaces.

## Scope
- Add `src/rebar/_plan_clarity.py` for the shared structural parser and hard-floor result.
- Update `src/rebar/_engine_support/gates.py` to apply the result to standalone clarity.
- Update `src/rebar/llm/plan_review/det_floor.py` to emit blocking P1 findings for the same defects.
- Add `tests/unit/test_clarity_floor.py` for focused unit and cross-surface regression tests.

## Testing
- Run the focused clarity-floor tests during the red-green cycle.
- Re-run existing direct-consumer coverage in `tests/interfaces/lifecycle/test_criteria_heading_collapse.py` and `tests/unit/test_code_review_artifact.py`.
- Run the repository lint, typecheck, and full test gates after the focused suite is green.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] A standard Acceptance Criteria checkbox whose fully joined body is whitespace-empty fails standalone clarity.
- [ ] A checkbox with a blank first line and a nonblank wrapped continuation passes the nonempty-item rule.
- [ ] Each specified sentinel-as-value form in an exact active execution section fails standalone clarity.
- [ ] Fenced code does not trigger the sentinel rule.
- [ ] Inline code does not trigger the sentinel rule.
- [ ] Ordinary prose mentions do not trigger the sentinel rule.
- [ ] Each specified same-line removal or negation assertion suppresses the sentinel rule.
- [ ] Plan-review P1 blocks on an empty joined checkbox body.
- [ ] Plan-review P1 blocks on an unresolved sentinel assignment.
- [ ] Plan-review P1 passes the historical `NO stale TODO` negative control.
- [ ] Focused tests, direct-consumer tests, lint, typecheck, and the full repository test suite pass.
